title: Analysis code for: Zero-shot time series foundation models for statistical postprocessing of weather forecasts: how much training data do they replace?
description: Python code that reproduces the tables and figures of the manuscript 'Zero-shot time series foundation models for statistical postprocessing of weather forecasts: how much training data do they replace?' (Avcı and Tan, submitted to Adv. Stat. Clim. Meteorol. Oceanogr., 2026). The pretrained time series foundation models TimesFM-3 and Chronos-2, used zero-shot with the ensemble mean as covariate, are compared with ensemble model output statistics (EMOS) variants, a distributional regression network and variance inflation, trained on subsets of the reforecast archive (year-round and season-matched), on rolling windows of recent forecasts and on other stations only, for probabilistic 2 m temperature forecasts at 49 German EUPPBench stations and lead times of 0-120 h, evaluated with the CRPS, coverage, rank histograms and Diebold-Mariano tests. The archive contains the analysis scripts, the aggregate results and the figures; the EUPPBench data (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7429236) and the model weights are not included.
